topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna constrains frequency planning, limiting concurrent beams and their individual bandwidths. Advanced digital channelizers and adaptive beamforming optimize allocation, reducing interference. Non-linear effects in high-power amplifiers distort signals, but predistortion and backoff mitigate these effects.
reference_context: SatCom systems optimize spectral efficiency with digital channelizers, adaptive beamforming, and polarization diversity.
